prose: So next we build that out. cairn restart and cairn cc.x restart and slash restart. We only need to have you around to supervise the process the first time. Once we know it works we don't have to do any of that. And now, as I finish typing this, it looks like you've already finished at least part of it (remote doesn't show me everything you're doing in the same way that being there does) No, cairn restart does not restart the running cc instance(s). Otherwise yes, approved all the way to proved. Do not request further reviews unless you have more questions
